evidence: Examined 2 pages; the single Organization node at http://localhost:8000/#org declares @id, name, foundingDate, url and address, and no sameAs. No off-site profile is therefore linked from the entity the site publishes.

evidence_refs.observation: jsonld[0].fields_present is [@id, name, foundingDate, url, address]; sameAs absent

exceptions_checked: brands with no off-site presence to point at, for which the recommendation is to establish one first rather than to fabricate links
false_positive_controls_applied: checked every JSON-LD block on every sampled page, not only the home page
treated the node as anchored if sameAs appeared on any page, since one site-wide declaration is sufficient

suggested_action.how: Add the URLs of profiles the brand actually controls and that name it back. Each target must be verifiable in both directions; a sameAs pointing at a profile that does not mention the brand weakens the claim rather than strengthening it.
suggested_action.mechanism: Identity disambiguation: an entity reachable from several independent addresses is resolvable, where an entity asserted only on its own domain is not.
suggested_action.success_criteria: Every sameAs target resolves and names the brand, and the Organization node can be matched to an external entity record without guessing.
suggested_action.summary: Add sameAs links from the Organization node to the profiles the brand already controls off-site.
suggested_action.what: A sameAs array on the existing Organization node listing the brand's own off-site profiles.
suggested_action.where: The JSON-LD Organization block in the site-wide head, at http://localhost:8000/#org.
suggested_action.why: The node currently asserts an identity that nothing off-site can be matched against, so a retrieval system holding two entities with similar names has nothing to break the tie with.

title: Organization node has no sameAs identity anchors
